notes: Notes on the parts. **Pre-wave state:** the state AFTER the wave-F bundle (see section 0). **New objects only:** the five feature migrations create 15 new `kafaa_*` tables (FS60/FS61 `hc_metrics`, `hc_disclosures`, `skill_pilots`; FS62/FS63 `national_tags`, `tag_links`, `role_occupations`; FS64/FS65 `regional_demand`, `provider_commitments`, `pledges`, `pledge_progress`; FS66/FS67 `programme_alignments`, `programme_graduates`, `fellowships`, `fellowship_milestones`; FS69 `prearrival_shares`) with RLS in the per-statement form, their RPCs and internal helpers; none of them redefines a shared function. **QA part:** `kafaa_fs7qa_integration_p1` replaces `kafaa_verify_record_share` (same signature and grants; adds the `purpose` key on an active link so the public verify page labels an FS69 pre-arrival share) and holds the one guarded row update listed in 1a (the FS48 mentoring card, carried over from wave E: the wave-E bundle part `kafaa_fs5qa_integration_p2` on the parked `fsE-integration` branch did the same, but PR #1 (`fsE-integration-qa`) never carried it; if that part was already applied live the card is at version 14 and this statement matches no row). **Seed rows** load with `kafaa.seeding` on: the two synthetic provider organisations before commitments and pledges, the FS60 metrics before the disclosures, strategy-level national tags before pillars and links, the FS32 record shares `rs-pa-*` before the pre-arrival shares, the four `nt-pa-*` notices with the rest. No evidence, no person-skill row and no digest is seeded, so there is no `kafaa_skills_apply` replay part. No new policy resource or grant: no `kafaa_policy_matrix` rows to insert. **Expected drift after live use:** an HR director demo release adds rows to `kafaa_regional_demand`; journeys add commitments, pledges, shares and audit rows.
